output.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 111 to 77 lines (31%) and from 7,941 to 5,328 characters (33%). Five peripheral trees expand meaningful concepts: gesture settlement, projection, selection, routing, and workspace lifetime/persistence. [M], [C], and [O] represent modular structure, calls, and ownership; [D] describes computational dependencies across those boundaries. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps; edge references use 1-based raw lines.

Source-grounded corrections and qualifications: MappingPage.tsx mounts drafts after activation and retains inactive mounted views, so the seed's 'each opened document' is narrowed. MappingEditorRuntime.ts:144-147 cancels the entire clone batch when any clone is unsupported, rather than removing only unsupported clones. shapeProjection.ts:36-43 excludes viewport-space non-conversation nodes and code-panel/source-code projections from its shape pass. MappingPage.tsx:788-808 gives created projection-copy undo/redo a child-only replacement path that preserves the source archive and unrelated sessions; the seed's description of coordinating both histories needs this qualification.

Additional details come directly from the pinned sources: copy-document resets and session subscriptions in canvasWorkspace.ts; save-time version validation in MappingPage.tsx; membership modification in selectionState.ts; geometry guards and hierarchy repair in displayModel.ts; structural sharing and focus invalidation in CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx; worker failure handling in NativeRoutingStore.ts; and retained mapped-source context in MappingCanvas.tsx. CanvasSession store visibility and dirty calculations are grounded in canvasSession.ts; editor/camera cleanup is grounded in MappingEditorCanvas.tsx. Imported controller, persistence, router, and source-service implementations are not supplied, so their internals are not inferred beyond visible calls and contracts. Only context.json and seed.json supply architectural evidence.

Transient connection routing [D/O/C]
|-- CanvasRuntime resolves semantic edge anchors
|   `-- Endpoint rect made owner-local; carries owner's layoutKey
|-- NativeRoutingStore.sync(grids, edges)
|   |-- Delete measurements for removed grids; retain router entries for edges
|   |-- Same layoutKey -> reuse obstacle owner

|   `-- On completion, dispatch pending job
